hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Europe, bordering the North Sea, between Belgium and Germany || mostly coastal lowland and reclaimed land (polders); some hills in southeast || located at mouths of three major European rivers (Rhine (Rijn), Meuse (Maas), and Scheldt (Schelde)); about a quarter of the country lies below sea level and only about half of the land exceeds one meter above sea level || Resources: natural gas, petroleum, peat, limestone, salt, sand and gravel, arable land || Exports: refined petroleum, vaccines, machinery, crude petroleum, broadcasting equipment (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly coastal lowland and reclaimed land (polders); some hills in southeast || Western Europe, bordering the North Sea, between Belgium and Germany

climate.excerpt: temperate; marine; cool summers and mild winters || flooding volcanism: Mount Scenery (887 m), located on the island of Saba in the Caribbean, last erupted in 1640; Round Hill (601 m), a dormant volcano also known as "The Quill," is located on the island of St. Eustatius in the Caribbean; these islands are at the northern end of the volcanic island arc of the Lesser Antilles that extends south to Grenada

economy.excerpt: high-income, core EU- and eurozone-member economy; strong services, logistics, and tech sectors; strongly trade-oriented with heightened risks from global tensions; declining inflation aided by easing energy prices and wage growth; rising but manageable deficits and public debt; strong ratings for innovation, competitiveness, and business climate || Exports: refined petroleum, vaccines, machinery, crude petroleum, broadcasting equipment (2023) || Industries: agroindustries, metal and engineering products, electrical machinery and equipment, chemicals, petroleum, construction, microelectronics, fishing
